# Aim Analytical

> > Premier provider of refurbished analytical laboratory instruments and plant testing services, specializing in Agilent chromatography and mass spectrometry systems.

Aim Analytical (operated by Analytical Instrument Management) specializes in selling high-quality refurbished Agilent laboratory equipment including GC, HPLC, GC/MS, LC/MS, and ICP-MS systems. The company also operates a hemp testing laboratory and offers equipment buyback services, helping laboratories access premium analytical instruments at reduced costs while promoting sustainability.

- Agilent Technologies
- Refurbished Equipment

- ICP-MS (Inductively Coupled Plasma-Mass Spectrometry)
- Triple Quadrupole

## Refurbished Chromatography Systems

- [Refurbished Agilent GC Systems](https://aimanalytical.com/laboratory-instruments/agilent-gc-systems): Gas chromatography systems offering high-performance analytical separation for organic compounds and volatile substances
- [Refurbished Agilent HPLC Systems](https://aimanalytical.com/laboratory-instruments/hplc-systems): High-performance liquid chromatography systems for complex mixture analysis and compound identification
- [Refurbished Agilent GC/MS Systems](https://aimanalytical.com/laboratory-instruments/agilent-gcms-systems): Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry triple quadrupole systems combining separation and molecular detection capabilities
- [Refurbished Triple Quadrupole LC/MS Systems](https://aimanalytical.com/laboratory-instruments/lcms-qqq-systems): Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry systems for sensitive quantitative analysis of complex samples
- [Refurbished Agilent ICP-MS Systems](https://aimanalytical.com/laboratory-instruments/icpms-systems): Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry systems for trace element and heavy metal analysis

## Equipment Services

- [Sell Your Agilent Equipment](https://aimanalytical.com/sell-your-agilent-equipment): Service for selling used Agilent laboratory instruments to AIM at fair market prices
- [Agilent uECD Detector Disposal](https://aimanalytical.com/agilent-uecd-disposal): Specialized disposal and compliance management services for Agilent micro-electron capture detectors

## Laboratory Services

- [Hemp Testing Laboratory](https://aimanalytical.com/hemp-testing): Plant and hemp testing facility providing analytical testing services for botanical compounds and cannabinoid analysis
